subscriptions.lead: Your DocBook plan, trial, usage and payments.
subscriptions.off_text: Subscriptions are not active on this platform. Your clinic can use DocBook as it is.
subscriptions.readonly_title: Your clinic is in read-only mode
subscriptions.readonly_text: The subscription has ended. You can still open and export all records; saving changes is paused until the subscription is renewed.
subscriptions.current_sub: What your clinic is subscribed to now.
subscriptions.pay_sub: Transfer the amount, then send us the transfer reference. We confirm it and extend your subscription.
subscriptions.reference_hint: Please write the invoice number {number} in the transfer notes.
subscriptions.reported_text: Reported on {date} by {method}, reference {reference}. You can correct the details below.
subscriptions.reference_help: The transfer or CliQ reference number, or the receipt number.
subscriptions.choose_sub: Prices are per clinic. The new plan starts after the current paid period or trial.
subscriptions.no_plans_text: DocBook has not published plans yet. Your trial continues meanwhile.
subscriptions.replace_confirm: You already have an invoice waiting for payment. Choosing a plan now replaces it with a new invoice.
subscriptions.choose_hint: An invoice is issued; nothing is charged automatically.
subscriptions.data_note: Your patients' records always stay yours: even without an active subscription you can open and export them.
subscriptions.chosen_done: Invoice issued. Pay by transfer and send the reference below.
subscriptions.notice_done: Thank you. We received your payment notice and will confirm it shortly.
subscriptions.blocked_data_safe: Nothing has been deleted. You can still open, print and export all records.
subscriptions.blocked_ask_owner: Please ask the clinic owner or manager to renew the subscription.
subscriptions.banner_expired: Records stay available to view and export. Renew to continue saving.
subscriptions.banner_expired_staff: Records stay available to view. Saving is paused until the clinic renews.
subscriptions.banner_past_due: The paid period has ended. {n} days left before the clinic becomes read-only.
subscriptions.banner_trial_last: Last day of your free trial.
subscriptions.banner_trial: {n} days left in your free trial.
subscriptions.banner_trial_hint: Choose a plan to keep working without interruption.
subscriptions.remind_trial_title: Your free trial ends in {n} days
subscriptions.remind_trial_body: The DocBook trial of {clinic} ends on {date}. Choose a plan to keep working without interruption.
subscriptions.remind_period_title: Your paid period ends in {n} days
subscriptions.remind_period_body: The paid period of {clinic} ends on {date}. Pay the next period to avoid interruption.

ent.website_white_label: Hide the platform line in the site footer
ent.clinic_max_branches: Branches allowed (1 = main branch only, empty = no limit)

subscriptions.branches_help: The price depends on the number of branches. The main branch is the clinic itself.
subscriptions.too_few_branches: This package includes up to {n} branch(es) only

subscriptions_admin.off_text: Clinics use DocBook without plans or limits. Prepare the plans, then turn subscriptions on in Settings.
subscriptions_admin.plans_lead: What the platform sells to clinics: prices, limits and included features.
subscriptions_admin.no_plans_text: Create the plans clinics can choose from.
subscriptions_admin.retire_confirm: Clinics use “{name}”. It will be deactivated and hidden instead of deleted.
subscriptions_admin.plan_retired: The plan is in use, so it was deactivated and hidden.
subscriptions_admin.features_help: Other modules check these keys with subscriptions.hasFeature(clinic, key).
subscriptions_admin.is_active_help: Inactive plans cannot be chosen or assigned to new invoices.
subscriptions_admin.is_public_help: Hidden plans can still be assigned by the platform admin.
subscriptions_admin.is_featured_help: Its card is highlighted in the pricing section of the home page.
subscriptions_admin.settings_lead: The switch, trial, grace period and the payment details shown to clinics.
subscriptions_admin.switch_help: When off, clinics see no banners, no limits and nothing is blocked.
subscriptions_admin.grace_help: After an unpaid period ends, before the clinic becomes read-only.
subscriptions_admin.trial_plan_help: The limits and features during the trial.
subscriptions_admin.trial_no_card_help: Shown to clinics on the subscription page.
subscriptions_admin.payment_help: Clinics pay by bank transfer, CliQ or cash and send a payment notice; you confirm it here.
subscriptions_admin.billing_name_help: The company that issues the invoices. Empty uses the product name.
subscriptions_admin.card_note: Online card payment for subscriptions is not available yet: payments are confirmed manually.
subscriptions_admin.enable_confirm: Every clinic starts a free trial now. When a trial or a paid period ends without payment, the clinic becomes read-only.
subscriptions_admin.disable_confirm: Banners, limits and the read-only mode stop at once for every clinic. Subscription records are kept.
subscriptions_admin.enabled_done: Subscriptions are on. Clinics start their free trial.
subscriptions_admin.subs_lead: Each clinic's plan, status, period end and payments.
subscriptions_admin.no_sub_text: This clinic has not been seen since subscriptions were turned on. Its trial starts on its next visit.
subscriptions_admin.readonly_now: This clinic is read-only now: its staff can view and export, but not save.
subscriptions_admin.void_confirm: Void invoice {number}? The clinic will no longer see it as due.
subscriptions_admin.cancel_confirm: Cancel the subscription of {name}? Access continues until the end of the paid period or trial, then the clinic becomes read-only.
subscriptions_admin.payment_confirm: Record this payment as received? The paid period is extended.
subscriptions_admin.period_end_help: Empty: one month or one year from the start.
subscriptions_admin.extend_help: Added to the current trial end, or counted from today if the trial is over.
subscriptions_admin.plan_confirm: Change this clinic's plan? The paid period does not change.
subscriptions_admin.plan_help: Limits and features follow the plan immediately. Use Record payment to extend the period.
subscriptions_admin.comp_confirm: Give {name} DocBook for free? It does not expire until you change it.
subscriptions_admin.comp_help: A free clinic keeps its plan's limits and features (or all features without a plan) with no end date.
subscriptions_admin.comped: The clinic now uses DocBook for free.
subscriptions_admin.bp_help: One branch costs the plan's price above. Enter the full plan price for 2, 3, 4 and 5 branches, or leave it empty to add the "each extra branch" price.
subscriptions_admin.bp_limit_help: The most branches this plan allows is set under features (Branches allowed).

errors_subscriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED: The clinic's subscription has ended, so it is read-only. Renew the subscription to save changes.
errors_subscriptions.PLAN_LIMIT_DOCTORS: Your plan allows {limit} active doctors and the clinic has {used}. Upgrade the plan to add more.
errors_subscriptions.PLAN_LIMIT_STAFF: Your plan allows {limit} staff logins and the clinic has {used} (including pending invitations). Upgrade the plan to add more.
errors_subscriptions.PLAN_LIMIT_APPOINTMENTS: Your plan allows {limit} appointments per month and this month has {used}. Upgrade the plan to add more.
errors_subscriptions.INVOICE_CLOSED: This invoice is already paid or void.
errors_subscriptions.PLAN_LIMIT_PATIENTS: Your plan allows {limit} patient records and the clinic has {used}. Existing records stay available; choose another package to add more.

clinic_types.title: Clinic types
clinic_types.lead: The types clinics choose from when they sign up and in their settings; they also show in the clinic directory.
clinic_types.builtin_sub: Untick to hide a type from new clinics. Clinics that chose it keep it.
clinic_types.name: Type
clinic_types.custom_sub: Add new types with an Arabic and an English name, and the website template clinics of that type start with.
clinic_types.in_use: A type clinics use cannot be removed — hide it instead.
clinic_types.new_hint: Type a name to add a new type when you save.
clinic_types.hidden_help: Changes show at once in sign-up and in clinic settings.
